project.name: jawelte tests/jpa-module scenario 75: a migration history table is not emptied by cleanup
project.description: #132: per-method cleanup works from the schema's real tables, so it reaches a schema-migration tool's history table too - and emptying that while leaving the DDL it describes puts the next migration in front of a schema no history remembers. db-migration-module contributes the well-known names to jpa-module's exclusion list, and this asserts both halves: the history row survives a cleanup boundary and an ordinary table is still emptied across the same one. Asserting only the first would pass just as well if cleanup had stopped working altogether.
